verses.1: Open our doors, and let fire burn in your halls.
verses.2: Hail, Beros! For the oak tree has fallen. The Adrims have been destroyed. Hail, Aloni Bashan! For the forest of bazzir has been destroyed.
verses.3: The cries of the wicked are lamentations, for their enemies have destroyed them. It’s a cry of despair, like that of those who are in despair. For the pride of the people has been destroyed.
verses.4: Thus said Jehovah, the God of Israel: “May you destroy the sheep that have been killed.”
verses.5: Those who commit these acts will be killed, and they will not be punished. And those who sell them will say, “Blessed is Jehovah!” I will do this, and their enemies will not be able to harm them.
verses.6: For I will no longer speak to the inhabitants of the earth, says Yahweh. And behold, I am bringing forth man from his mother’s womb, a man who is under the control of his neighbor and under the control of his king. And I will not save anyone from their hands.
verses.7: And I will take the killed sheep from there. The poor shepherds will have nothing to eat. I will give two leashes to each of them. I will call one “Noyaam” and the other “Chovlim”. Then I will take the sheep away.
verses.8: And I destroyed those three evil ones on one day. My heart became sorrowful because of them, and their hearts also were filled with sorrow.
verses.9: And he said, “I will not let you die. The dead will not remain dead forever. Those who are left will be eaten by their own flesh.”
verses.10: And I will take my staff and my arrows, and I will use them to break the covenant I have made with all nations.
verses.11: And on that day, they knew that it was indeed the word of Jehovah. The poor shepherds who took care of me knew this too.
verses.12: And he said to them, “If it is good in your eyes, then take my wages. But if not, then stop and consider my wages—thirty pieces of silver.”
verses.13: And the LORD said to me, “Throw him into the hands of the potter.” I will take thirty pieces of silver from them and give them to the potter.
verses.14: And I will inform the second messenger about those weapons that are meant to break up the alliance between Judah and Israel.
verses.15: And the LORD said to me, “Take all these good things with you.”
verses.16: For behold, I will build up a house in the land that is desolate. The young man will not be harmed, and he will not be taken away. The woman will not be healed; she will not be dressed. But in the land of health, he will eat, and his fruits will be abundant.
verses.17: Oh Lord, you evil god! You have left the seeds in a state of destruction. The seeds are rotting on their own, and their right eyes will also be destroyed. They will be completely ruined.
